question: What has been told to the addressed one, and to whom is it addressed?
premises: This practice of the soul is the thing referred to.
It has been told to you.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: The practice of the soul has been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of that practice is not repeated in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
